children: Four.Meme said on X that BNC4 Daily Buyback has completed its first repurchase and burn, removing 10,169,329 4Stock from the market. According to Odaily, the tokens were worth about $355,900.
The buyback was funded by all product revenue generated by BNC4 on September 8 and 9, including 115,057 USDT and 11,652 BNC4 in LP fees, as well as 33,930 BNC4 in Bonding Curve trading fees.

Four.Meme also said rankings will reset daily from now on, and 100% of BNC4's daily product revenue will be used to buy back the top-ranked eligible BNC4 paired community meme coins each day and burn them entirely.

title: Four.Meme Completes First BNC4 Daily Buyback and Burn of 10,169,329 4Stock
